result.summary: This residential intersection features a sidewalk and a curb ramp but lacks marked crosswalks to guide pedestrians. Visibility is significantly hindered by dense mature trees and a low wall at the corner, which may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The lack of painted crosswalks at the intersection fails to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way or alert drivers to potential crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense mature trees and a low perimeter wall at the corner block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right corner of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim low-hanging tree branches and ensure the corner remains clear of obstructions to improve sightlines between all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure pedestrians are visible to drivers during nighttime or low-light conditions.

result.summary: This residential intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and stop-controlled approaches. However, safety is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings, poor pavement quality, and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles and dense vegetation.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and mid-ground roadway

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface within the intersection is cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left and dense foliage on the right corner limit visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left curb line and right corner area

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all users.

interventions.title: Pavement rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth walking surface.

result.summary: A residential street intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control. The roadway is wide and unmarked with visible pavement degradation, though sidewalks are present along the residential properties.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No designated crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven road surface can affect vehicle handling and create trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the roadway surface

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: No sloped transitions from the sidewalk to the street, creating barriers for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all intersection corners.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add lane markings to narrow the travel lanes and organize traffic flow, which can help reduce vehicle speeds.

result.summary: This is a residential intersection with sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks marked crosswalks. The environment is generally low-speed, but sightlines are partially obstructed by a vehicle parked close to the corner and tall hedges.

hazards.name: Corner Parking
hazards.description: A white vehicle is parked very close to the intersection corner, obstructing sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground, parked at the curb near the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Tall, dense hedges at the corner property may obscure shorter pedestrians, such as children, from the view of drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center, along the property line at the corner

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The lack of marked crosswalks at a residential intersection reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian activity.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area in the foreground and center

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance, slow turning traffic, and physically prevent illegal parking at the corner.
